description: Source code for OpenAiCodexHandler class, which manages interactions with OpenAI's Codex API using OAuth authentication, including request building, streaming response handling, and error management.

classes.name: OpenAiCodexHandler
classes.description: Class that handles communication with OpenAI Codex API, including request creation, response streaming, error handling, and model management.

methods.name: createMessage

methods.name: handleStreamResponse

methods.name: processEvent

methods.name: getReasoningEffort
